paragraphs.text: Alchemy: Duskmourn is a MTG Arena -exclusive card set in the Alchemy -series that was released on October 15, 2024.

Alchemy: Duskmourn is a digital only release adjacent to the release of Duskmourn: House of Horror . There are thirty new designed-for-digital cards included in the set (10 uncommons, 15 rares, 5 mythic rares) . All of the cards are set on Duskmourn .

The digital-only mechanics Conjure , Draft , Heist , Perpetually , Not the starting player , Seek , and Spellbook are reused. From the main set, Room enchantments and their associated unlocking a door mechanics are reused; as are Eerie , Impending , Manifest dread and Survival . Cameo mechanics include Convoke , Double team , Enlist , Manifest (the regular version), and Rebound .
Mangled Soulrager is the first card to create a twelve-time boon .
( ) Endless Corridor conjures a copy of Solitary Study // Endless Corridor to your hand.

paragraphs.text: The Alchemy: Duskmourn Into the Future event was held on Magic: The Gathering Arena from October 15 to 17, 2024. It featured five phantom preconstructed decks intended to highlight how new cards could be used in the Alchemy format.
